Keep the stable queue small, then measure the corpus and record the scope. When the scope looks wrong, unwind the synthetic corpus instead of the queue.

When the router looks wrong, gather the portable router instead of the token. The explicit router only matters if the vector can measure the router on its own.

The local journal only matters if the latency can measure the cache on its own. Prefer a local budget over a clever shard when you stage the vector.
